title: Example product setup wizard
intro: This is a small example of the steps.json format. Copy it, rename it steps.json in your product folder, and replace the text.

variables.label: Business name
variables.help: The name of your business. Used in the app title.

variables.label: GitHub username
variables.help: Your GitHub user name or organization name.
variables.pattern_error: Use letters, numbers and dashes only.

variables.label: Repository name
variables.help: The name of your copy of the repository.
variables.pattern_error: Use letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores only.

variables.label: Repository URL
variables.help: Worked out for you from your GitHub username and repository name.

variables.label: Support email (optional)
variables.pattern_error: Enter an email address like help@example.com.

steps.title: Tell the wizard about your business
steps.instructions: Enter your business name and GitHub details once. The wizard keeps them and fills them into the next steps. The support email is optional. You can skip it.
steps.verify_hint: The 'Your values' box at the top shows at least 3 values saved.

steps.title: Make your own copy of the code
steps.instructions: Open the product repository on GitHub. Click Fork. Name your copy {{repo_name}} in the account {{github_username}}.
steps.verify_hint: Open {{repo_url}} in your browser. You see {{business_name}}'s copy of the code.

steps.title: Add your own keys in your own account
steps.instructions: Open the settings page of your hosting account. Add each key there. Never type a key into this wizard.
steps.checkbox_label: I added my keys in my own account
steps.verify_hint: The hosting dashboard lists every key name from the product README.
